title: Ordinary normalization of a total derived strict-limit cone
statement: Let A be a Grothendieck abelian category with inverse-sequence limits, countable products, chosen derived categories of A and its strict inverse-sequence category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and countable products in D(A). Let R with comparison eta be any total right derived functor of termwise inverse limit. For every complex X of strict inverse sequences, there is a homotopy-limit cone [def-weil-derived-limit] with point R(QX) on the tower n |-> Q(X_n). Its nth leg p_n satisfies eta_X followed by p_n = Q(lim-projection_n at X). The equality fixes the ordinary-limit normalization; no exactness of products or boundedness is assumed.

proof.text: Reuse totalDerivedData, evaluationData and CoreWork.roos_Q from the fully proved generic construction in RingedStrictTowerHomotopyLimit. The tower category is Grothendieck, its functorial K-injective resolutions have injective tower terms, evaluation preserves K-injectivity, and products of the evaluated resolutions represent derived products. The split-transition difference sequence gives the natural Roos triangle.

Unfold pNat_app. Naturality of eta along the functorial resolution q cancels aIso, and naturality of the product comparison cancels bIso and the evaluated resolution. Thus eta_X followed by the Roos first arrow and the product of evaluation comparisons equals Q(inc_X) followed by the product comparison. Postcompose with each product projection to obtain precisely Q of the ordinary inverse-limit projection.

Identify the source towerTransitionEndomorphism with one minus towerShift using product extensionality. coneOfComp and its distinguished-triangle criterion supply the homotopy-limit cone. Transport it along the evaluation comparison and rightDerivedUnique to the supplied R and eta. The defining rightDerivedNatTrans_app equation cancels the transport in the normalization identity.

theorem normalizedStrictLimitBase
    {A : Type a} [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{g} A]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A)]
    [HasLimitsOfShape ℕᵒᵖ A] [HasCountableProducts A]
    [HasCountableProducts (DerivedCategory A)]
    (R : DerivedCategory (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ DerivedCategory A)
    (η : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ A).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙
      DerivedCategory.Q ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ R)
    (hR : R.IsRightDerivedFunctor η
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) (.up ℤ)))
    (X : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) :
    ∃ p : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ).obj (R.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj X)) ⟶
        X.asFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q,
      IsHomotopyLimit (Cone.mk _ p) ∧
      ∀ n : ℕ, η.app X ≫ p.app (op n) = DerivedCategory.Q.map
        ((NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex (lim.π (op n)) (.up ℤ)).app X)
